field.label: API Key
field.comment: Paste the API key from your IDEA89 merchant dashboard.

field.label: Catalogue Sync Key
field.comment: Needed for your catalogue to sync. Create it in your IDEA89 dashboard under API & Domains and paste it here. Your API key is visible in your storefront's page source; this key stays on your server, so only your store can change your products, prices and offers. Click Test Connection after saving to check it.

field.label: Assistant Name
field.comment:
The name shown above the conversation, e.g. "Aria" or "Shop Helper". It is also how the assistant refers to itself when a shopper asks.

Shared with your IDEA89 dashboard. This name is stored in your IDEA89 account rather than in Magento, so it is the same in both places. If IDEA89 cannot be reached when you save, nothing is changed and Magento will tell you so.

field.label: Test Connection
field.comment: Verifies the API key and connection to IDEA89.

field.label: Sync Now
field.comment: Pushes products, categories, and CMS pages to IDEA89. Runs automatically every night.

group.label: Widget Appearance
group.comment: Theme, brand colour and fonts are set in your IDEA89 dashboard (Settings → Widget), with a live preview.

field.label: Load With Subresource Integrity
field.comment:
Yes: the widget loads from a fixed copy with an integrity hash, so the browser refuses it if it is ever altered on the way. Security scanners and PCI DSS 6.4.3 reviews look for this on every third-party script.
Changes you make in the IDEA89 dashboard then reach your storefront when Magento's page cache refreshes, instead of within five minutes. Flush the page cache to see a change at once.
No (default): the widget always loads its latest version.

group.label: Content Sync
group.comment: Choose which content types are sent to IDEA89 to enrich the assistant's knowledge.

field.label: Sync Products
field.comment: Sync your product catalog (recommended: Yes).

field.label: Sync Categories
field.comment: Lets the assistant know what product categories your store has.

field.label: Sync CMS Pages
field.comment: Sync About Us, FAQs, contact pages etc. so the assistant can answer policy questions.

field.label: Sync Store Info
field.comment: Sends store name and context description to IDEA89.

field.label: Excluded Attributes
field.comment: Product attributes not to send to IDEA89, such as display or admin settings that are marked visible on the storefront. Ones that look like settings are listed first; none is excluded until you select it. Run Sync Now after changing this.

group.label: Store Locator
group.comment:
✨ Pro plan feature. The Store Locator is included on the Pro tier and above. If you're on Starter, upgrade in your IDEA89 dashboard to use these settings.
Online-only retailer? Set Enable Store Locator below to No and the page and chat-widget locator both disappear from your storefront.
All content fields fall back to sensible defaults when blank. Leave layout blank to inherit the global setting from your dashboard.
Tip: you can embed the locator inside any CMS page via the IDEA89 Store Locator widget.

field.label: Enable Store Locator
field.comment:
Yes: the store finder page is live and the CMS widget renders.
No: the page returns 404 and the CMS widget renders nothing. Pick this if you sell online only.
Note: the chat assistant only suggests showrooms if you've seeded locations in the dashboard, so online-only stores naturally never see them either way.

field.label: URL Path
field.comment: The URL slug for the store finder page, e.g. store-finder, showrooms, stores, find-a-shop, store_locator. Lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens (-) and underscores (_) only. Anything else is stripped on save. Leave blank to use store-finder. The save will fail with a clear error if the path already belongs to a Magento module, CMS page, product, or category. Cache flush required after change.

field.label: Page Layout
field.comment: Fullwidth = edge-to-edge map (recommended); Boxed = max-width rounded card. Overrides the dashboard setting when not blank.

field.label: SEO Page Title
field.comment: Browser tab + search-result title. Default: "Find a store".

field.label: SEO Meta Description
field.comment: Shown in search results under the page title. Aim for 140–160 characters.

field.label: Hero Eyebrow
field.comment: Small label above the page title, e.g. "Showrooms", "Where to buy", "Visit a branch". Default: "Showrooms".

field.label: Hero Title (H1)
field.comment: Main page heading. Default: "Find a store near you".

field.label: Hero Subhead
field.comment: One-line introduction below the title.

field.label: Help Section Heading
field.comment: The heading of the help block below the map.

field.label: Help Section Body
field.comment: A short paragraph offering help. Often used to mention phone support or live chat.

field.label: Help CTA Label
field.comment: Button text below the help message, e.g. "Get in touch", "Contact us".

field.label: Help CTA URL
field.comment: Where the help button links to. Can be a relative URL (/contact), an external URL, or a mailto: link.

group.label: Checkout Experience
group.comment:
Choose how far the assistant carries a shopper towards a completed order. Each option below is a step up from the one before it. Pick one.
Agentic Commerce at the bottom is separate: it lets AI agents outside your store (for example ChatGPT) buy from you, and works alongside any option above.
Cache flush required after any change here.

field.label: Assistant Checkout Mode
field.comment:
Off: when a shopper says “checkout”, the assistant sends them to your cart page. This is how the assistant has always behaved.
Express handoff: the assistant shows a basket summary in the chat and one button that goes straight to your checkout, skipping the cart page. No change to your checkout at all.
Checkout in chat: your own Magento checkout opens inside a panel over the chat. Your payment methods, your shipping rules, your extensions. IDEA89 never sees a card number. Run Test Checkout Panel below before switching this on.
Native checkout (beta): the assistant asks for delivery details in the conversation and places the order for you. Offline payment methods only unless you say otherwise. Best suited to trade and invoice-billed stores.

field.label: Cart URL Path
field.comment: Leave blank for Magento's default /checkout/cart/. Change only if an extension has moved your cart page.

field.label: Checkout URL Path
field.comment: Leave blank for Magento's default /checkout/. One-step-checkout extensions often use their own path, e.g. /onestepcheckout/.

field.label: Test Checkout Panel
field.comment: Checks your theme, extensions and payment methods for anything that stops the checkout rendering inside the assistant. Run this before switching the mode to "Checkout in chat".

field.label: Pinned Checkout Bar
field.comment: Shows a full-width "Checkout · N items · total" bar above the message box whenever the shopper's basket has items. Works alongside the Assistant Checkout Mode above and routes through the same checkout. It just gives the shopper a second, always-visible way to reach it. Hidden automatically on an empty basket.

field.label: Checkout Display
field.comment:
Shared with your IDEA89 dashboard. This setting is stored in your IDEA89 account rather than in Magento, so it is the same value in both places: changing it here updates your dashboard, and changing it in the dashboard updates this field. If IDEA89 cannot be reached when you save, nothing is changed and Magento will tell you so.

Full window gives checkout the whole screen and hides the conversation behind it. In the chat keeps checkout inside the assistant panel alongside the conversation.

field.label: Payment Methods the Assistant May Use
field.comment:
Beta. On this setting the assistant collects delivery details in the conversation and places the order itself. Start with an offline method and place a test order before offering it to shoppers.
Nothing is selected by default, which means the assistant will not place orders at all, so shoppers get the Express handoff instead. Methods marked works in chat complete without leaving the conversation. Anything else needs the shopper to go to your checkout page to pay, so selecting it gains you nothing here.

field.label: Let AI agents shop your store
field.comment:
Publishes your catalog in the Agentic Commerce Protocol format so assistants such as ChatGPT can find and recommend your products. This is separate from the Assistant Checkout Mode above and works alongside any of those settings.
Turning this on does not give anyone access to your orders, customers, or payment details.

field.label: Publish the Product Feed
field.comment: Serves your visible products at /idea89/acp/feed.json, including out-of-stock ones, which are published flagged as out of stock rather than left out. Disabled products, products not visible individually, and products outside this website are never included.

field.label: Agent Access Token
field.comment: A shared secret agents send as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Leave blank to serve the feed publicly (it contains only what is already on your product pages).

group.label: Order Tracking
group.comment:
Included on every plan. When a shopper asks "where is my order?" or similar, the chat assistant surfaces a compact order card directly in the widget. Logged-in customers see their last few orders; guests provide an order number and email.
Order data is fetched from your Magento store directly by the shopper's browser. It never travels through the IDEA89 servers or the AI model. Carrier tracking links open in a new tab. Customise the support fall-back below.

field.label: Enable Order Tracking
field.comment: When No, the assistant won't surface an order card and the order endpoints under /idea89/orders/* refuse 404.

field.label: Contact Support URL
field.comment: Where the "Contact support" button on the order card sends shoppers. Can be a path (/contact), an absolute URL, or a mailto: link. Default: /contact.

field.label: Contact Support Button Label
field.comment: Text on the support button. Default: "Contact support".

field.label: Max Recent Orders Shown
field.comment: How many of the most recent orders to show a logged-in customer when they ask about their orders. 1–10. Default: 3.

field.label: Show Carrier Tracking Button
field.comment: When Yes, the order card shows a "Track parcel" button that opens the carrier's tracking page in a new tab (when a carrier link is available). Set to No if you'd rather direct shoppers to the support button only.

group.label: Personalization
group.comment: Lets Aria recognise logged-in customers and confirm live prices/stock. Create the Signing Secret in your IDEA89 dashboard (Settings → Widget → Personalization) and paste it below.

field.label: Enable Personalization
field.comment: This is the Magento half only. Personalization also has to be switched on in your IDEA89 dashboard before it runs. The panel above shows what both halves are currently doing.

field.label: Signing Secret
field.comment: Server-side HMAC secret shared with IDEA89. Never exposed to the browser.

field.label: API URL (Server-side)
field.comment: Used for product sync from Magento to IDEA89. For local dev with Docker: http://host.docker.internal:3000

field.label: Widget URL (Browser-side)
field.comment: Used for the chat widget script tag loaded in the shopper's browser. For local dev: http://localhost:3000. Leave blank to use the API URL.
